_doc: Ambient one-liners NPCs say out loud (speech bubbles). Keys: role, 'infamous' (when the Causality Graph says they've heard of you), 'crisis:<id>', 'station', 'combat', 'pair' (NPC-to-NPC small talk).
civilian: Is it just me or did the air get pricier?
My lungs are on a payment plan.
Don't make eye contact with the ads.
I sold my dreams to Lumen. They're running them as reruns.
Three jobs and I still can't afford silence.
Heard the Odd Duck is back in port. Smells like it.
My kid wants to be a shareholder when she grows up.
Paragon fined me for loitering in my own shadow.
merchant: Air canisters! Bottled at the source! The source is a vent!
Everything must go! Including me, if Halcyon finds out.
recruit: Anyone hiring? I'll work for air.
I need off this rock. Like, yesterday.
Looking for a crew that isn't a cult. Or is a fun cult.
infamous: I hear they rob vending machines for fun.
Hide your credits, the drifter's here.
combat: I'm calling Paragon! ...Their hold music is so long!
pair: ...and then the billboard ASKED me how my day was.
Protein Paste tastes like regret today.
You hear about the debt strike?
Lumen said it's sunny. It's raining. Lumen's never wrong.
My cousin got repossessed last week.
station: This station's been dead since the repo drones moved in.
Cryo-bay's full of collateral. Some of them still snore.
Halcyon's drones are scanning everything. Even the rats.
crisis:air_bubble: Breathing futures are up again. I'm shorting my lungs.
crisis:debt_strike: We're not paying! They can't repossess ALL of us. ...Can they?
crisis:paste_recall: They found a tooth in Batch 88. Not a human tooth. Not an animal tooth.
crisis:ad_overload: Even my dreams have unskippable ads now.
crisis:compliance_week: Report a neighbour, win a toaster! I already reported myself twice.
